description: This file is a comprehensive implementation of a Talk Mode Manager for an iOS application, handling speech recognition, text-to-speech synthesis, push-to-talk functionality, and interaction with a chat gateway. It manages microphone permissions, speech recognition, incremental speech processing, voice synthesis with fallback options, and maintains state related to voice and model configurations.

classes.name: StreamFailureBox
classes.description: A thread-safe container for capturing errors during stream operations, utilizing NSLock for synchronization.

classes.name: TalkModeManager
classes.description: A final class managing the state and behavior for voice interaction modes, including speech recognition, TTS, and chat interactions.

methods.name: attachGateway
methods.description: Associates a GatewayNodeSession instance with the manager for event and message handling.

methods.name: updateGatewayConnected
methods.description: Updates the connection state with the gateway and triggers recognition start when connected.

methods.name: updateMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the main session key and manages chat subscriptions.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the talk mode, initiating or halting recognition accordingly.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Activates listening, requests permissions, configures audio, and begins speech recognition.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops recognition, speech output, cancels ongoing tasks, deactivates audio session, and resets state.

methods.name: suspendForBackground
methods.description: Temporarily suspends microphone usage without full deactivation, suitable for app backgrounding.

methods.name: resumeAfterBackground
methods.description: Resumes recognition if it was suspended during backgrounding.

methods.name: userTappedOrb
methods.description: Stops speech output when user interacts with the UI control.

methods.name: beginPushToTalk
methods.description: Starts push-to-talk operation, requesting permissions, and configuring recognition.

methods.name: endPushToTalk
methods.description: Stops PTT, processes final transcript, and initiates chat response.

methods.name: runPushToTalkOnce
methods.description: Performs a single PTT session with timeout and auto-stop management.

methods.name: cancelPushToTalk
methods.description: Cancels ongoing PTT session, resets recognition, and resumes listening if needed.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Configures and begins speech recognition, handling partial and final results.

methods.name: restartRecognitionAfterError
methods.description: Attempts to restart recognition after transient errors during continuous listening.

methods.name: stopRecognition
methods.description: Halts speech recognition and cleans up associated resources.

methods.name: makeAudioTapAppendCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback block that appends audio buffers to recognition requests and logs levels.

methods.name: handleTranscript
methods.description: Processes partial or final transcript results, managing recognition interruption based on speech activity.

methods.name: startSilenceMonitor
methods.description: Initiates a background task that monitors for silence and triggers processing if detected.

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Determines if speech has been silent for a duration and triggers processing.

methods.name: schedulePTTTimeout
methods.description: Schedules automatic stop of PTT session after a maximum duration.

methods.name: handlePTTTimeout
methods.description: Handles timeout event, stopping push-to-talk when limit is reached.

methods.name: finishPTTOnce
methods.description: Completes the PTT operation and resumes normal recognition.

methods.name: processTranscript
methods.description: Sends the recognized transcript to the chat gateway and manages assistant response.

methods.name: subscribeChatIfNeeded
methods.description: Subscribes to chat events for a given session key, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: unsubscribeAllChats
methods.description: Removes all chat subscriptions.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Builds the chat prompt with context, including interruption points.

methods.name: sendChat
methods.description: Sends a chat message to the server and returns the run ID.

methods.name: waitForChatCompletion
methods.description: Waits for chat completion event or timeout, returning the chat state.

methods.name: waitForAssistantText
methods.description: Polls for assistant reply text since a given timestamp, with timeout.

methods.name: fetchLatestAssistantText
methods.description: Fetches recent assistant messages from chat history.

methods.name: playAssistant
methods.description: Handles playback of assistant's speech response, including TTS synthesis and fallback.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Stops ongoing speech output and cleans up incremental synthesis tasks.

methods.name: shouldInterrupt
methods.description: Determines if incoming speech should interrupt current output based on matching.

methods.name: shouldAllowSpeechInterruptForCurrentRoute
methods.description: Checks audio route to see if barge-in is allowed based on output type.

methods.name: shouldUseIncrementalTTS
methods.description: Indicates whether incremental TTS should be used, currently set to true.

methods.name: applyDirective
methods.description: Applies voice and model directives from TTS instructions.

methods.name: resetIncrementalSpeech
methods.description: Resets incremental speech buffers and tasks.

methods.name: cancelIncrementalSpeech
methods.description: Cancels incremental speech operations.

methods.name: enqueueIncrementalSpeech
methods.description: Adds a speech segment to the incremental speech queue.

methods.name: startIncrementalSpeechTask
methods.description: Begins asynchronous processing of incremental speech segments.

methods.name: cancelIncrementalPrefetch
methods.description: Cancels ongoing prefetch of incremental speech chunks.

methods.name: cancelIncrementalPrefetchMonitor
methods.description: Cancels monitoring task for incremental prefetch activity.

methods.name: startIncrementalPrefetchMonitor
methods.description: Initiates background task to prefetch future speech chunks.

methods.name: ensureIncrementalPrefetchForUpcomingSegment
methods.description: Ensures prefetch is active for the next speech segment.

methods.name: startIncrementalPrefetch
methods.description: Begins prefetching speech chunks for a segment.

methods.name: completeIncrementalPrefetch
methods.description: Marks prefetch as complete with fetched chunks.

methods.name: clearIncrementalPrefetch
methods.description: Clears a prefetch when cancelled or errored.

methods.name: failIncrementalPrefetch
methods.description: Handles failure during prefetching.

methods.name: consumeIncrementalPrefetchedAudioIfAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves prefetched audio chunks for a segment if available.

methods.name: resolveIncrementalPrefetchOutputFormat
methods.description: Determines preferred output format for incremental speech prefetch.

methods.name: finishIncrementalSpeech
methods.description: Finalizes incremental speech, flushing buffers and ending tasks.

methods.name: handleIncrementalAssistantFinal
methods.description: Processes final incremental assistant text and updates context.

methods.name: streamAssistant
methods.description: Streams assistant's incremental speech segments from server events.

methods.name: updateIncrementalContextIfNeeded
methods.description: Updates the current incremental speech context if necessary.

methods.name: buildIncrementalSpeechContext
methods.description: Constructs context for incremental speech synthesis based on directives.

methods.name: ensureIncrementalPre fetchForUpcomingSegment
methods.description: Ensures prefetch is active for the next speech segment.
